reason: Half my stylists are not comfortable typing in English, so an English-only app means I end up doing the billing myself or it sits unused. And I don't like paying ₹10,000 upfront plus another monthly bill on top of what I already pay for.
objection: It is only in English. My staff speak Odia and Hindi, and if they find it difficult they will go back to the notebook and I will have wasted ₹10,000. I also don't want another monthly payment that never stops.
would_change_my_mind: If the app works in Odia and Hindi for my stylists, and they let me try it free for a month before I pay the ₹10,000.
